study: Olson et al. 2012, Pathway Project cognitive-strategies PD (SAUSD RCT), AERJ
delivery_evidence: Pathway teachers received 46h of in-person PD plus coaching (extraction design note; same Pathway PD format as the sister SAUSD/AUHSD studies which specify in-person released days + afterschool sessions + veteran-teacher coaching). NOTE: the OA manuscript body text is glyph-scrambled so verified via design note + sister studies Olson 2017/2020.
test_alignment_evidence: Included outcomes are the researcher/developer-made Assessment of Literary Analysis (ALA) on-demand writing assessment (researcher_made) and the California Standards Test (CST) ELA, a state standardized assessment (standardized_independent) (Tables 3-4).
curriculum_evidence: Pathway PD is built around a cognitive-strategies tool kit and curriculum materials that teachers then use in class (consistent across the Pathway studies; Olson 2017/2020 'cognitive strategies tool kit and curriculum materials'); coded bundled for this same intervention.
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted wave is the Year 2 (2008-09) end-of-treatment spring posttest, same school year (Table 3; extraction notes).
